prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Create a beautifully art-directed photorealistic premium fashion merchandise lookbook board for FLIXIE AFTER HOURS, everyday collection. Reference 1 supplies the EXACT softened F symbol: rounded F plus separate short lower-right bar, retain proportions and gap. Reference 2 supplies existing Flixie wordmark, preserve lettering never retype it. Landscape board on warm bone paper, clean editorial arrangement, ample space. Three hero products with realistic cotton texture and subtly lit shadows: washed midnight heavyweight oversized T-shirt front and small back view, tiny lilac F embroidered on wearer left chest (32mm wide), back plain; midnight unstructured six-panel cap with bone F embroidery 28mm high; washed charcoal heavyweight hoodie front and back, front tiny lilac F, back large bone Manrope bold stacked typography reading exactly 'STAY FOR / THE CREDITS.' and small lilac F below. Hoodie back graphic approximately 280mm wide, visible and legible. Small supporting flat artwork swatches underneath products showing isolated F and the typography design with no cloth. Bottom small mint sticker with midnight original F, and peach rectangular sticker reading 'AFTER HOURS' in midnight, tiny original Flixie wordmark on midnight packaging card. Palette midnight #120A24, bone #F3F0E9, lilac #B9A0FF; restrained supporting mint #65D6C4 peach #F1A77A only on stickers. Purple remains brand family, no rainbow use. Header 'After Hours / The everyday collection'. Footer 'CONCEPT MOCKUPS — NOT PRODUCTION PROOFS'. Elevated contemporary independent cinema club / fashion label, not corporate giveaway. No film characters, reels, play buttons, popcorn, neon, gradients, distress graphics or invented logos. All F symbols must match reference exactly.

Use case product-mockup. Create a photorealistic premium FLIXIE AFTER HOURS editorial capsule merchandise board. Two reference images: exact rounded F monogram with detached lower-right bar from reference1, existing original Flixie wordmark reference2. Preserve these not invent another brand. Wide warm bone background, luxury independent cinema magazine styling, meticulous cotton/canvas texture. Products: 1) bone heavyweight oversized tee BACK prominently shown with large midnight elegant Newsreader Medium-style serif typography exactly 'Stay for / the credits.' across two or three carefully composed lines, small peach horizontal bar under credits, tiny lilac F at lower right of graphic; small FRONT companion view with small lilac F left chest. 2) generous natural bone canvas tote with thick midnight handles, same serif editorial phrase large and left-aligned across three lines, ONE short peach underline within same print position, tiny lilac F at lower right; tote seen hanging with realistic folds. 3) statement midnight tee BACK with enormous original lilac F filling most back, beneath it a small mint sans-serif line 'BETTER WATCHED TOGETHER'; small front view plain except original flixie wordmark on back-neck label not new lettering. Palette #120A24 midnight, #F3F0E9 bone, #B9A0FF lilac purple family, peach #F1A77A ONLY on editorial tee/tote, mint #65D6C4 ONLY on social tee. Add clean isolated flat artwork panels along bottom mirroring the designs, no garment distortion, clear label 'Flat artwork / concept'. Header 'After Hours / The editorial collection'. Tiny footer 'CONCEPT MOCKUPS — FINAL LETTERING AND COLOURS FOLLOW VECTOR ARTWORK'. Keep exact headline spelling. Use restrained layouts and spacing, contemporary fashion merch people choose to wear, no illustrations or cinema cliches, no movie IP, no fake certification, no invented dates or claims or extra text, no alternate logos. Accurate reference F geometry including separate bar, no play triangles. Make the serif typography a real elegant editorial contrast to functional Manrope sans serif labels. Not a corporate swag catalog.
